The topology auditor's high confidence mask suggests the wig shape is coherent, but it doesn't rule out the internal texture issues. I agree with the Router's severity for hand collapse but would elevate the global texture/blur issue to a moderate structural concern due to the 'waxy' look of the skin and hair.
